cohort: The study included data from 27 randomized controlled trials involving women in labor, identified from a Cochrane Systematic Review.
finding: Intention-to-treat (ITT) meta-analysis underestimates the effect of receiving epidural analgesia in labor on cesarean section compared with instrumental variable (IV) meta-analysis.
mod_finding: ITT meta-analysis underestimates the effect of receiving epidural analgesia in labor on cesarean section compared with IV meta-analysis.
